_comment: Each scenario's xml field is a Go text/template. Available placeholders: {{.PaymentID}} {{.OrderID}} {{.Amount}} {{.Currency}} {{.Description}} {{.Name}} {{.Email}} {{.StartDate}} {{.LastDate}}. To add a scenario, copy a real Medoro callback XML, replace the order-specific values with placeholders, escape the double quotes for JSON and append an entry.

scenarios.label: Card approved (3-D Secure)
scenarios.description: State 6, ActionCode 000, frictionless 3DS (ECI 5). Credits are granted.

scenarios.label: Apple Pay
scenarios.description: State 6, ActionCode 000, wallet payment (ECI 5, no ACS). Credits are granted.

scenarios.label: Google Pay
scenarios.description: State 6, ActionCode 000, wallet payment (ECI 5). Credits are granted.
